Anna Chen: Heads-up team — external assessment next Thurs 09:00-17:00 UTC (assessors requested). Need to align on retest slots, RBAC snapshots, KMS audit proofs, and a clean evidence handoff. @Mike SRE can you confirm oncall bridge + ephemeral role window?
Mike SRE: I can own the bridge. Proposing a 1hr retest window daily Mon-Wed after the initial report (09:00-10:00 UTC) so we have capacity. Will open ephemeral roles for the assessor during that hour.
Raj Patel: Thanks. For KMS: assessors want to validate key usage logs. We should export CloudKMS audit logs + envelope key metadata. Maria — is there an approved S3 bucket for upload? Also we need to timestamp a KMS key rotation snapshot before the test.
Maria Ops: Use s3://redwood-pt-evidence/uploads. I will create a presigned PUT folder for the assessor (expires in 7 days). Will tag uploads with `assessor-id` and `report-id`. Ephemeral role details: assume-role ARN will be created with 1hr TTL, start aligned to the bridge.
Assessor Jane: Quick scope note: we'll be doing both network-level probes and targeted load on /v1/infer endpoints at low QPS (<= 5 r/s) to verify request handling. We need signed evidence uploads and a list of users who can approve replays.
Kevin D: Replays need approval from Security + Service Owner. Suggest adding a Canary fallback so we can quickly route traffic off the main cluster if things degrade. Example policy snippet: ```json
{
  "fallback": "small-quantized-model",
  "threshold_ms": 500,
  "max_error_rate": 0.05
}
```
Raj Patel: For RBAC changes, we won't change prod perms during the test. We'll snapshot IAM/roles and include diffs in the evidence bundle. Command to snapshot (GCP): `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > iam-snapshot.json` — please commit snapshot to the evidence S3 path before 08:00 UTC on test day.
Anna Chen: Can someone own the evidence checklist? I can own triage tracker but need an evidence lead to guarantee artifacts uploaded.
Maria Ops: I'll own evidence ingestion. Checklist items: 1) IAM snapshot, 2) KMS audit export (last 90 days), 3) Audit log tail for the test window, 4) Presigned upload link created, 5) Temp role ARN and expiration.
Mike SRE: I'll post the bridge link in #release-war-room and ping oncall. Also will create a short runbook for rollback corridor: 
```
- If p99 latency > 1s for 3 consecutive minutes -> failover to dedicated pool
- If error rate > 3% -> trigger canary fallback policy
- Notify security@redwood immediately
```
Raj Patel: One more KMS detail — assessors want envelope key fingerprints. Run: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key KEY_NAME --location LOCATION --format=json` and capture `protectionLevel` and `algorithm`. Put output in `kms-snapshot.json`.
Assessor Jane: We'll need to mark any findings as "observation" vs "vulnerability" during intake. Please route anything that looks like data exfil or key exposure immediately to `sec-incident@redwood`.
Kevin D: For retest scheduling: after we ship fixes, retest slots will be allocated in the same S3 folder under `retests/`. Ops will coordinate a dry-run 24h before the assessor's slot to validate upload pipeline.
security-bot: Reminder: company PT policy (docs/internal/sec/pen-tests.md) requires minimum 7 days notice for production traffic tests and 48h blackout declaration for deployments.
Anna Chen: Good catch. We have 8 days, so we're OK. Action items recap: 
- Maria: create presigned upload + owner for evidence (due EOD today)
- Mike: bridge + rollback runbook + ephemeral roles (due EOD today)
- Raj: produce IAM + KMS snapshot templates + export commands (due EOD today)
- Kevin: draft retest slot calendar and canary config (due tomorrow)
- Assessor Jane: confirm final scope and upload acceptance format (due EOD today)
Maria Ops: noted, will post S3 path and presigned link here when ready.
Mike SRE: Starting work now, will update with bridge URL.
Raj Patel: I'll prepare a short `evidence_readme.md` (format + required fields) and drop into s3://redwood-pt-evidence/uploads/README.
Assessor Jane: Thanks all — we'll start light scans during the first hour, escalate findings via the bridge.
Anna Chen: Closing loop — once evidence ingestion is validated, we'll confirm retest calendar. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
